# Each way a loop can be rejected is reported with its own reason and the stage
# that produced it: the shape of the loop header (lower), an operation simd
# cannot express (plan), or the loop's context (analysis).

loopvec -json .
cmpenv stdout stdout.want

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func NotCounted(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(dst); {
		dst[i] = a[i] + 1
	}
}

func RangeNotDefined(dst, a []float32) {
	var i int
	for i = range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + 1
	}
}

func StartNotZero(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := 1; i < len(dst); i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i] + 1
	}
}

func ConditionNotLess(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := 0; i <= len(dst)-1; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i] + 1
	}
}

func StepNotOne(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(dst); i += 2 {
		dst[i] = a[i] + 1
	}
}

func BoundNotInvariant(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(dst)/2; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i] + 1
	}
}

func DownStartNotLast(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := len(dst); i >= 0; i-- {
		dst[i] = a[i] + 1
	}
}

func DownBoundNotZero(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := len(dst) - 1; i >= 1; i-- {
		dst[i] = a[i] + 1
	}
}

func DestinationOffset(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i+1] = a[i] + 1
	}
}

func OperandCall(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = float32(len(a)) + a[i]*abs(a[i])
	}
}

func abs(x float32) float32 { return x }

func BodyIfGuardedStore(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		if a[i] > 0 {
			dst[i] = a[i]
		}
	}
}

func BodyTwoStatements(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		x := a[i] + 1
		dst[i] = x
	}
}

func TypeString(dst, a, b []string) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}

func OpInt64Mul(dst, a, b []int64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] * b[i]
	}
}

func FloatMax(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = max(a[i], 0)
	}
}

func ZeroFill(dst []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 0
	}
}

func Vectorized(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + 1
	}
}
